name: qfd_n59_qbank11a-qb11a-COMMIT
purpose: QW-N59SVC qbank11 (10-20 21:40): structural successor of qbank10/_c (gate GRT FAIL: total overflow 25,188 / 24,575 at 21% usage, ~95% of the overflow cells in the central column channel x 400-500 um, full height: every macro's 1,653 pins are on its E face, so the col-1 macros' faces AND the centred N/S pin bands all funnel into the one 38.2-um central channel). Fix: central channel 81.4 um (columns 2-3 shifted +43.2 um on the 43.2 lattice), outline 950.4 x 475.2, pin bands shifted +21.6 um to stay centred on the central channel. RTL/params/benches identical to qbank10 (census PASS max 32 stands). Smaller widening (+43.2 um) parallel fallback; CTS 2-level clustering.
